     PRO SE INTERVENOR JOHN B. BRADLEY, III’S MOTION TO CORRECT
  ATTACHMENT B SOAH ORDER 30 AND COMPEL ACCURATE IDENTIFICATION
                   OF AFFECTED ROUTE SEGMENTS

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:

COMES NOW John B. Bradley III, Pro Se Intervenor and steward of the Lazy S Ranch,
and respectfully files this Motion to Correct SOAH Order No Attachment A and B and
Compel Accurate Identification of Affected Route Segments, and in support thereof
would show:

    I.      BACKGROUND

    1. On June 5, 2026, SOAH filed Order No 30, including Attachments B, in PUC
       Interchange Item 5835 which aligns intervenors and exhibits to A Party Number
       and serves as the basis for grouping intervenors by route segment and for the
       proposed order of presentation and cross-examination at the Hearing on the
       Merits.

    2. Attachment B contains an apparent error regarding the route segments affecting
       the Lazy S Ranch and Intervenor John B. Bradley aka John B. Bradley III and
       Bradley Family including Danielle Bradley, Jett Bradley (aka John B. Bradley IV)
       and Brooks Bradley (aka John B. Bradley Jr.).




59475 – Motion to Correct                                                      Page 1 of 4
    3. Applicants' filing incorrectly identifies the Lazy S Ranch under route segments
      G73, G81, and G82.

   4. However, Intervenor's testimony, exhibits, maps, correspondence with
      Applicants, Statements of Position, and prior filings consistently identify the Lazy
      S Ranch as affected by route segments E8, E9, F21, F22, and G71.

   5. These route segments are the subject of Intervenor's testimony and objections
      regarding impacts to historic resources, habitable structures, springs, the
      registered artesian well, wildlife habitat, and other landowner concerns.

   II.    NEED FOR CORRECTION
   6. SOAH Order No. 23 directed Applicants to group intervenors by route segment
      for purposes of hearing administration and presentation.

   7. Accurate identification of affected route segments is necessary to ensure an
      orderly hearing, proper witness grouping, meaningful cross-examination, and a
      complete record.

   8. The current designation inaccurately associates Intervenor with route segments
      that are not the subject of his testimony and fails to identify the route segments
      that are actually at issue on the Lazy S Ranch.

   9. Left uncorrected, the error may create confusion regarding the scope of
      Intervenor's testimony, prejudice the presentation of evidence, and impair
      efficient administration of the hearing.

   III.   REQUEST FOR RELIEF

   10. Intervenor respectfully requests that the Administrative Law Judges direct SOAH
       staff to promptly review and correct Attachment B to accurately reflect that the
       Lazy S Ranch and John B. Bradley III are affected by route segments E8, E9,
       F21, F22, and G71.

   11. Intervenor further requests that any hearing presentation schedule, witness
       grouping, or cross-examination order derived from Attachment B be updated
       accordingly.

PRAYER

WHEREFORE, PREMISES CONSIDERED, John B. Bradley III respectfully requests
that the Administrative Law Judges:

a. Grant this Motion;

                        MOTION TO CORRECT ATTACHMENT B TO SOAH ORDER 30 JOHN B. BRADLEY
                                                                   PUC DOCKET NO. 59475
                                                            SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-26-16349
                                                                                Page 2 of 4
 b. Order SOAH staff to correct Attachment B to SOAH Order 30 to accurately identify
the route segments affecting the Lazy S Ranch as E8, E9, F21, F22, and G71;

c. Direct that any witness grouping, presentation schedule, or cross-examination order
be conformed to the corrected route segments; and

d. Grant such other and further relief, at law or in equity, to which Intervenor may show
himself justly entitled.

Respectfully submitted,



John B. Bradley III
Pro Se Intervenor

Respectfully submitted,
